body:
Deferred from T-34: SessionState (EncryptedSharedPreferences) isn't observable,
so a Settings currency change only applies on the next list open. Options: an
in-memory StateFlow mirror beside SessionState that Settings writes through, or
piggyback on SyncStatus-style app singletons. Covered today by ListViewModelTest
"currency change reflected by the next list view (A10)".
title: Android: default-currency change should reflect in an already-open list
